title: Orbit repo profile
description: The facts the orbit-starter skills read about a repo. A missing optional key means the step that needs it is skipped.

baseBranch.description: The branch PRs target and worktrees start from.

worktree.description: How a fresh worktree is made runnable.

copy.description: Gitignored files to copy from the main checkout.

link.description: Paths to share with the main checkout through a symlink or junction.

gates.description: Commands that must pass before a PR opens, scoped to what changed where the tool can.

serve.description: How to run the app locally, when a lane needs it.

prLink.description: How a PR names its story. Defaults by tracker kind: AB#{id} (ADO), {key} (Jira), Closes #{id} (GitHub Issues).

lanes.description: Path globs to build-lane agents. Anything unmatched goes to orbit-starter:builder.

consults.description: Which consults run before a build. Each is optional.

ux.description: true turns it on and the story's triage decides whether it runs; an object adds a condition that forces it.

maxOpenPrs.description: Open-PR cap the engine reads from gh. Separate from Orbit's storyWipCap.

merge.description: What the monitor does with a PR that is approved and green.

resolveThreads.description: Whether review threads get resolved after a fix.

runbook.description: Path to a markdown file of repo facts: required checks, known flakes, reviewer team, false trails.

qa.description: Turns on orbit-starter:qa-tester. The harness, URLs, and login come from the runbook's QA section.

deployWorkflow.description: Name of the CI workflow that deploys the QA target. The deploy gate checks a green run of it at or after the merge commit. Absent means the runbook says how to prove a deploy.

testStates.description: Board column names that hold stories waiting on a QA pass, used when the user names no story.

stack.description: Turns on orbit-starter:stack, which cuts a feature built on one integration branch into stacked PRs.

graph.description: "nx" for the built-in adapter, or a command that prints { nodes: { name: { root } }, dependencies: { name: [name] } } as JSON. Absent means slices are cut by layer paths alone.

layers.description: Slice layers, base first. A changed file lands in the first layer whose paths match; the rest land in an "other" slice.

spine.description: Shared files every slice touches, assigned key by key. Defaults to package.json and package-lock.json.

verify.description: Command that proves a slice builds alone; {base} is the ref it stacks on. Runs in the slice's own worktree. Absent means gates.lint and gates.test, which proves a build only if the test command compiles everything; set this to the build-and-test command otherwise.

cutRoot.description: Folder for the cutting worktrees. Defaults to .stack-cut beside the repo.

review.description: Facts the review skills and agents read. Both members are optional.

sizeBands.description: Line counts review-bloat judges growth against. A missing key means the agent measures the repo's own distribution.

fileNit.description: A file past this many lines is a nit. Usually the repo's 95th percentile.

fileImportant.description: A file past this many lines is important. Usually the 99th percentile.

fileGrowth.description: Lines added to a file already past fileNit before it is worth a split suggestion.

functionNit.description: A function past this many lines is a nit. Defaults to 50.

functionImportant.description: A function past this many lines is important. Defaults to 100.

riskGlobs.description: Extra path rules for risk-size.js, checked before its built-in globs. First match wins.

weight.description: Multiplier on changed lines. 0 means nobody reviews the file.

bucket.description: generated, test, docs, style, auth, contract, integration, state, server-logic, client, or other. The bucket picks the review agents.
